verdict.rationale: Fivetran ships a REST API for setting up/scaling pipelines programmatically, a Connector SDK for custom Python connectors, dedicated AI coding-agent plugins (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI) that let agents build/test/deploy connectors via natural-language CLI prompts, and an MCP server exposing read/write/delete operations for managing connections headlessly — together covering scaffold, configure, and run without a UI.  Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration that an agent can chain connector creation, transformation, and destination setup into one fully automated end-to-end run, and any third-party validation of the AI CLI plugins' reliability.
